iddr.summary: Generic input DDR register: samples d on rising and falling clock edges into two registers, then re-registers both on the rising edge to output aligned q1/q2.

anchors.name: genblk1.d_reg_2

anchors.why: Rising-edge realign register driving q1.

anchors.name: genblk1.q_reg_2

anchors.name: q1

anchors.name: q2

oddr.summary: Portable DDR output register: vendor ODDR primitives for Xilinx/Altera, otherwise a generic model that drives q from d1 on rising edge and registered d2 on falling edge.

anchors.name: d2

anchors.name: q
